newsitem.title: USA: A.T. Cross sees lower '96 sales, earnings.
newsitem.headline: A.T. Cross sees lower '96 sales, earnings.

text.p: A.T. Cross Co, which makes fine writing instruments, said on Tuessday it expected its net income for the year ending December 31, 1996 to be off about 50 percent, with sales off about six percent.
In 1995, the company reported sales of $191.1 million and net income of $13.4 million or $0.81 per share.

President and Chief Executive Officer Russell Boss said the domestic quality writing industry was experiencing little, if any, growth and most consumers of quality writing instruments were not yet aware of Cross's new product lines.
